decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed single-storey rear extension and outbuilding, because of their position, design and appearance, are compatible with the character and appearance of the property, and will not harm neighbours' living conditions. The works are consistent with the adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines (October 2003).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The extension outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 65 Mornington Crescent.    ].
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and the erection of a single storey detached outbuilding for use as a garden shed and playroom to house
